description: Append-only protection contract for repository-root files in cryptoxdog/IB-Odoo_19. Read by the governed publish path (validate_root_file_protection.py). The mechanical guarantee is the gate plus the ALLOW-ROOT-DELETION marker; purely additive changes and brand-new files pass.

rules.additive_only: Strict. A PR may only add lines. Any removal or in-place rewrite of an existing line (or whole-file deletion) fails the gate unless a matching ALLOW-ROOT-DELETION justification marker is present in the PR's commit messages.
rules.managed: Human-edited operational file. Edits are allowed without a marker but the file is routed for human review.
rules.regenerable: Machine-generated artifact rewritten wholesale by tooling; exempt from the additive check.

justification.recorded_in: any commit message in the PR range (base..head)

pr_template.required_when: any additive_only protected_files path is in the PR diff

tiers.canonical: Build, dependency, CI-gate and environment-modifying surface. rule=additive_only.
tiers.managed: Living/operational docs and infrastructure files gated for human review. rule=managed.
